title: Red-bulb lamps

recommendation.title: Two routes for the Zoo Med RS-50
recommendation.text: Cheap clamp: Fluker’s 5.5-inch dimmer model. Real brass: Industrial Light Electric is a conditional lead, not a confirmed pairing.
recommendation.test: Beser·Win B08RBJCJZR: 25W / LED listing; do not use with a 50W heat bulb without a qualifying fixture label.

caveat: No hands-on pairing tests. Secure hot fixtures, follow bulb/fixture clearances, keep away from bedding and skin, and switch off before sleep.
evidenceNote: Prices exclude shipping and tax. Brass base needs a separate incandescent-rated dimmer; Leviton TBL03 black is $18.07. Two other brass designs excluded because their maker warns against high-heat bulbs. Product evidence below.

sources.title: Why other real-brass designs were not shortlisted
sources.note: Maker advises avoiding other high-heat bulbs. Its brass pendant and swing lamp are not recommended here for RS-50 despite nominal 75W incandescent ratings.

sources.title: Beser·Win B08RBJCJZR compatibility check
sources.note: Current listing says Wattage 25 watts and recommends LED bulbs no greater than 25W. No 50W incandescent approval established. Ceramic socket alone is insufficient; do not rely on dimming to compensate.

sources.title: Leviton TBL03 plug-in dimmer — black $18.07
sources.note: 120V AC, 300W incandescent maximum. Available. Needed only for plain on/off bases; do not stack with built-in dimmers. Shipping/tax unknown.
